set.body:
Journey: See. Track: engine.

Outcome
Tables under phenotype/, and participants.tsv, sessions.tsv and scans.tsv, are understood as tables with dictionaries. The question "participants with resting BOLD, an EEG recording and a MoCA total below 26" returns a frozen selection.

Why
Files under phenotype/ are stored without interpretation today. Participant queries know only the columns of participants.tsv, by bare column name. Questionnaires are how behavioural and clinical measures reach the repository, and Neurobagel needs the dictionary (OPEN3).

Acceptance
1. phenotype tables, participants.tsv, sessions.tsv and scans.tsv files are assessed: key columns; any header BIDS allows, not only letters, digits and underscore; dictionary entries (description, units, levels, missing codes) from the JSON of the same stem. Problems are findings that name the row or column. Coverage shows these files as assessed.
2. A query can test a variable and names its table, for example the column total of phenotype/moca. Equality and numeric comparison are supported, and behaviour on missing values is stated. Values stay as written. Numeric parsing never coerces missing or censored values.
3. Table identity is part of every fact, so the same column name in two tables stays distinct.
4. A subset view includes a phenotype table whole or not at all, and leaves it out unless the steward includes it. Column-level permissions are later work.
5. The dictionary viewer delivered in D10 shows these definitions. Extra dictionary keys, such as Neurobagel's Annotations, are preserved byte for byte.
6. Reference and PostgreSQL answers match a hand-written oracle that includes missing values.

Not in scope
The REDCap adapter (parked as D08). Mappings across studies. Longitudinal models.

Start from
- modules/kernel/src/main/scala/sanctity/kernel/Query.scala.
- modules/bids/src/main/scala/sanctity/bids/ParticipantTable.scala line 36.
- modules/bids/src/main/scala/sanctity/bids/BidsScopes.scala line 29: phenotype is a reserved, preserved directory today.
- docs/streaming-tables.md.

Evidence
The shared lifecycle suite on both catalogs. The query step in SEE8.
